2.w: “Be patient with me a little longer, and I will instruct you, for I still have words to speak on God’s behalf.

3.w: With my knowledge I will speak comprehensively, and to my Creator I will ascribe righteousness.

4.w: For in truth, my words are not false; it is one complete in knowledge who is with you.

5.w: Indeed, God is mighty, and he does not despise people; he is mighty, and firm in his intent.

6.w: He does not allow the wicked to live, but he gives justice to the poor.

7.w: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; but with kings on the throne he seats the righteous and exalts them forever.

8.w: But if they are bound in chains and held captive by the cords of affliction,

9.w: then he reveals to them what they have done and their transgressions, that they were behaving proudly.

10.w: And he reveals this for correction and says that they must turn from evil.

11.w: If they obey and serve him, they live out their days in prosperity and their years in pleasantness.

12.w: But if they refuse to listen, they pass over the river of death and expire without knowledge.

13.w: The godless at heart nourish anger; they do not cry out even when he binds them.

14.w: They die in their youth, and their life ends among the male cultic prostitutes.

15.w: He delivers the afflicted by their afflictions; he reveals himself to them by their suffering.

16.w: And surely, he drew you from the mouth of distress, to a wide place, unrestricted, and to the comfort of your table filled with rich food.

17.w: But now you are preoccupied with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice take hold of you.

18.w: Be careful that no one entices you with riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.

19.w: Would your wealth sustain you, so that you would not be in distress, even all your mighty efforts?

20.w: Do not long for the cover of night to drag people away from their homes.

21.w: Take heed; do not turn to evil, for because of this you have been tested by affliction.

22.w: Indeed, God is exalted in his power; who is a teacher like him?

23.w: Who has prescribed his ways for him? Or said to him, ‘You have done what is wicked’?

24.w: Remember to extol his work, which people have praised in song.

25.w: All humanity has seen it; people gaze on it from afar.

26.w: “Yes, God is great—beyond our knowledge! The number of his years is unsearchable.

27.w: He draws up drops of water; they distill the rain into its mist,

28.w: which the clouds pour down and shower on humankind abundantly.

29.w: Who can understand the spreading of the clouds, the thunderings of his pavilion?

30.w: See how he scattered his lightning about him; he has covered the depths of the sea.

31.w: It is by these that he judges the nations and supplies food in abundance.

32.w: With his hands he covers the lightning and directs it against its target.

33.w: His thunder announces the coming storm, the cattle also, concerning the storm’s approach.
